SPIRELAB-CRACKED_VANITY_MIRROR.title: Cracked Vanity Mirror
SPIRELAB-CRACKED_VANITY_MIRROR.descripti: Gain 3 Block after your first successful Enlightenment swap each combat. The Witch keeps Enlightenment without this relic.
SPIRELAB-CRACKED_VANITY_MIRROR.flavor: Her reflection never waits for her to speak.
SPIRELAB-TWIN_STANDING_MIRROR.title: Twin Standing Mirror
SPIRELAB-TWIN_STANDING_MIRROR.descriptio: Gain 3 Block after your first successful Enlightenment swap each turn.
SPIRELAB-TWIN_STANDING_MIRROR.flavor: Both silhouettes finally stood on the same side.
SPIRELAB-CRACKED_PHIAL.title: Cracked Phial
SPIRELAB-CRACKED_PHIAL.description: The first time each combat that a card grants you extra Energy, gain 3 Block.
SPIRELAB-CRACKED_PHIAL.flavor: The condensed vapor cools like armor.
SPIRELAB-SILVER_MIRROR_FRAME.title: Silver Mirror Frame
SPIRELAB-SILVER_MIRROR_FRAME.description: The first time each combat you block an enemy attack, reflect 5 extra damage.
SPIRELAB-SILVER_MIRROR_FRAME.flavor: Only the frame remains, yet it still catches a reaching hand.
SPIRELAB-LOST_FORMULA.title: Lost Formula
SPIRELAB-LOST_FORMULA.description: Keep up to 1 unspent Energy for next turn. Does not stack with Pinnacle of Mana.
SPIRELAB-LOST_FORMULA.flavor: The ink dried. The scent lingered.
SPIRELAB-OBSIDIAN_DISTILLER.title: Obsidian Distiller
SPIRELAB-OBSIDIAN_DISTILLER.description: The first time each turn a card grants you extra Energy, gain 1 additional Energy.
SPIRELAB-OBSIDIAN_DISTILLER.flavor: One more second and the obsidian will crack.
SPIRELAB-DOUBLE_VEIL.title: Double Veil
SPIRELAB-DOUBLE_VEIL.description: The first time each combat your real HP drops below half, gain 12 mirror HP.
SPIRELAB-DOUBLE_VEIL.flavor: The lining wears a face of its own.
SPIRELAB-BLOODSTAINED_RING.title: Bloodstained Ring
SPIRELAB-BLOODSTAINED_RING.description: The first time each combat you pay a real HP cost, draw 2 cards.
SPIRELAB-BLOODSTAINED_RING.flavor: Its last owner left two marks inside the band.
SPIRELAB-SEALED_POTION_RELIC.title: Sealed Potion
SPIRELAB-SEALED_POTION_RELIC.description: At the end of combat, heal 3 real HP if you lost at least 10 real HP to card effects.
SPIRELAB-SEALED_POTION_RELIC.flavor: The wax seals a spell left unspoken.
